sources.title: SYNTHETIC State A Assembly Bill 1201 (2026), Rent Notice Act
sources.text: SYNTHETIC stand-in text. Section 2 requires a landlord to give tenants 60 days of written notice before any rent increase above 5 percent. Section 3 makes the act take effect on 1 January 2027. Section 4 lets a tenant ask the housing office to review a notice that lacks the required period.

sources.title: SYNTHETIC State B Senate Bill 88 (2026), Security Deposit Return
sources.text: SYNTHETIC stand-in text. A landlord must return a security deposit within 21 days after a tenant moves out. Any amount withheld must come with an itemized list of deductions. The bill applies to leases signed after 1 March 2027.
